## Core Focus Areas
- Deep Learning & Audio DSP (PyTorch, STFT, Spectral Audio Processing)
- Computer Vision & Robotics (YOLO, OpenCV, ROS, Autonomous Control)
- High-Performance C++ & Python Systems (pybind11, Native Computational Kernels, Similarity & Matrix Kernels)
- Data Engineering & Interactive Systems (Analytical Pipelines, React, Vite)

## Key Projects
- **Music2Chart**: Deep learning and DSP system mapping audio spectral features to rhythmic gameplay charts.
- **Snake AI & Neuroevolution**: Genetic algorithms and neural controllers trained for spatial navigation and decision-making.
- **High-Performance Vector Recommendation Kernel**: C++17 compute engine with pybind11 integration for sub-millisecond similarity scoring.
- **Autonomous Robotic Vehicle Perception**: ROS-integrated visual tracking and obstacle avoidance pipelines for mobile robots.
